title: Which perturbation observable has which leading residual order
supersedes_nothing: T19 (2026-09-11) is unchanged; its verdicts and outputs stand as archived.
question: For a symmetric operator perturbed by a covariance error E and a training-sample error D, which displacement observable (invariant graph X, orthogonal projector P, principal angles, Frobenius norm of the projector displacement) has which leading residual order, and does that order differ between a generic error and a pure coupling error?

part_1_deterministic.rationale: Verifies a mathematical identity on specified matrices. No data is fitted and no scientific outcome is generated, so no seed split applies.

riccati_orders: order 2: Lam2 X2 - X2 Lam1 = -G22 X1 + X1 G11
order 3: Lam2 X3 - X3 Lam1 = -G22 X2 + X2 G11 + X1 G12 X1
derivation.claim_a: For a pure coupling perturbation (G11 = 0 and G22 = 0) the order-2 right-hand side vanishes identically, so X2 = 0 and the graph's first correction is O(eps^3).
derivation.claim_b: The orthogonal projector has diagonal blocks -X^T X + O(X^4) and X X^T + O(X^4), which remain O(eps^2) whether or not X2 vanishes.
derivation.claim_c: ||P - P0||_F = sqrt(2)||X||_F (1 + O(eps^2)), because the O(eps^2) diagonal part is Frobenius-orthogonal to the O(eps) off-diagonal part; so the norm residual is O(eps^3) for pure coupling even though the matrix residual is O(eps^2).

part_1_deterministic.tolerance: measured log-log slope within 0.25 of the predeclared integer order
edge_checks: zero perturbation leaves the projector exactly unchanged
block-diagonal E leaves the invariant subspace unchanged
eigenvalues repeated inside the retained block do not break the first-order formula
shrinking cutoff gap inflates the first-order graph
an exact tie at the cutoff makes X1 non-identifiable: reported, never divided through
the eigensolver residual floor is reported so numerical cancellation is distinguishable from mathematical failure

part_2_grid.estimator_fit_definition: one top-k subspace estimate computed from drawn data; engineered-perturbation arms that fit nothing are not charged

pilot.purpose: choose m values and verify the eta ranges are reachable; never used for confirmation

confirmation.purpose: scored against the acceptance rule below

regimes.in_domain: eta = eps*lambda_1/delta <= 0.1, the domain to which the 44 eta^2 remainder bound is restricted
regimes.stress: eta in [0.2, 1.3], the range the archived T19 actually tested; reported separately and never used to support the bound

error_sources: engineered covariance error in the sample eigenbasis (reproduces the archived T19 construction)
independently estimated covariance from m noise-only draws (population-basis error, not engineered)
recorded_per_fit: residual norms for all four observables

acceptance.in_domain: the measured ||dP||_F agrees with its first-order value within a factor of 1.5 on at least 90 percent of confirmation fits, and the residual slopes match the predeclared orders within 0.3
acceptance.stress: no acceptance criterion; descriptive only, labelled outside the proven domain

part_2_grid.failure_branch: If in-domain agreement fails, report the failure region by (family, eta, lambda_min) and do not adjust the grid to recover agreement.
part_2_grid.multiplicity: Orders are predeclared per (family, observable); no selection among observables after seeing outcomes.
part_2_grid.stopping: budget spent, or acceptance decided, whichever first

exit_criteria: the existing theorem left unchanged unless a separately reviewed derivation supports more
explicitly_not_claimed: any extension of the 44 eta^2 bound beyond eta <= 0.1
that a random grid passing establishes a theorem
